# Evidence Acceptance

An accepted test receipt identifies the active run, scoped target, exact provider and module locks, test classification,
inputs or fixtures, assertion outcomes, observation time, and cleanup or retention outcome when applicable. Evaluate
each assertion against the task acceptance criteria and preserve failures, skips, indeterminate outcomes, and
environment limitations distinctly.

Do not promote a test design to a passed result. Do not infer results from configuration, prior chat content, or a
receipt for another target or lock set. Expired, incomplete, mismatched, or unaccepted receipts require a capability
refresh request; unavailable capabilities remain blockers rather than a reason to downgrade acceptance criteria.
